briefings.title: CEO Fireside Chat With Jensen Huang and Pascal Daloz at Dassault Systèmes 3DEXPERIENCE World
briefings.tldr: NVIDIA and Dassault Systèmes announced a significant long-term strategic partnership, integrating Dassault Systèmes’ Virtual Twin technologies with NVIDIA’s AI and Omniverse platforms to create science-validated "World Models" that will redefine industrial design, manufacturing, and operations through generative AI and real-time simulation.

briefings.title: Building the Future of Industrial AI with NVIDIA
briefings.tldr: Dassault Systèmes and NVIDIA are forging their deepest partnership yet, combining Dassault Systèmes' virtual twin technology with NVIDIA's accelerated computing and AI to power a new "generative economy" and "knowledge factories," enabling real-time, AI-driven design, simulation, and operation across all industries.
